subject: NNGP-NAS kickoff — cheap architecture pre-screening
body:
Hi Bao,

Kickoff for the NNGP-NAS effort. Our open-source release shows you can compute NNGP validation accuracy for a NAS-Bench-101 model on a subset of CIFAR-10 and use it as a performance predictor — no training loop at all — and it ships the metrics to judge predictor quality: Kendall's Tau, correlation coefficient, PQETP (prediction quality for exceedance of threshold performance), and discovered performance.

Product: an architecture pre-screening service. Teams running searches burn full-training budget on candidates a cheap NNGP score would have rejected; we want screening to cut those wasted runs meaningfully.

Deliverables in the short window (02-02 to 05-04): (1) release notebook turned into a batch scoring service, (2) validation on an internal search workload, not just NAS-Bench-101, (3) a calibration study of when the predictor is trustworthy. Resourcing next, please.

Anders
